name: Queen Mama Chanter
effect: [Activate: Main] You may rest this Stage and add 1 card from the top or bottom of your Life cards to your hand: Add up to 1 of your Characters with a cost of 3 to the top of the owner's Life cards face-up.

official_faq.question: I used this [Activate: Main] effect to rest this Stage and add 1 of my Life cards to my hand. At this time, can I choose not to add 1 of my Characters with a cost of 3 to my Life cards?
Can I use this [Activate: Main] effect to add my Character with a cost of 2 or less to my Life cards?
official_faq.answer: No, you cannot. You can only add a Character with a cost of exactly 3 to your Life cards.

official_faq.question: Can I use this [Activate: Main] effect to add a Character card from my hand to my Life cards?
official_faq.answer: No, you cannot. When included in card text, "Character" refers only to Characters on the field.
